title: Chapter 20: Qingping
paragraphs: Upon running the search, Mr. Shi's brow immediately furrowed.
"It's showing as outside the Immortal Sect's territory?"
He reported this finding to The Boss, who, typically maintaining an impassive demeanor, paused in surprise, nearly suspecting the employee of playing a prank.
"Our satellite access is limited to locating the Immortal Sect's Grotto-Heavens and Blessed Lands. Since we can't pinpoint the location, it must be beyond the sect's borders."
Mr. Shi finished his explanation, and The Boss nodded slowly.
"Very well, I understand. Keep a close watch on this account and notify me immediately of any new developments."

Until they could confirm with absolute certainty that it was indeed a Soul Transformation Patriarch, they dared not disturb the Nascent Soul Venerable in his seclusion. For now, they had no choice but to proceed cautiously.
The group nodded in unison.

Chen Mobai remained anxious, fearing that the operators of the "Cultivation Assistant" might have pinpointed his location, drawing the attention of Immortal Sect law enforcement cultivators for questioning.
Only after two days passed without any inquiries did he finally relax.
That evening, Chen Mobai once again entered the Water Abode, inhaling the pure spiritual energy permeating the surroundings and nodding in satisfaction.
Thanks to this Second-Tier Treasure Land, coupled with his relentless diligence, his cultivation realm was steadily advancing.
At his current pace, he estimated that he could attempt breaking through to the Sixth Layer of Qi Refinement within another two months.
Yet this progress still felt insufficient.

Within his class, Song Zheng and Yan Bingxuan had already reached the Seventh Layer of Qi Refinement. Across the entire grade level, twelve students had attained this realm, all guaranteed admission to the two local Dao Academies.
Compared to them, Chen Mobai's Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement was utterly insignificant.
Moreover, three "academic gods" at the Eighth Layer of Qi Refinement were considered the "Heaven's Chosen," with potential admission to the Four Great Dao Academies.
Expanding the scope to all of Danxia City—including both private and public schools—the number of geniuses became countless.

Take the Heavenly Spiritual Root holder at Immortal Sect First High School, for example. They had already been earmarked for Gou Mang Dao Academy upon enrollment. Additionally, two geniuses with Variant Spiritual Roots had received early admission offers from Natural Palace.

Rumor had it that some high schools had students at the Ninth Layer of Qi Refinement, but most were concealing their strength, waiting to make a splash during the college entrance exams and secure admission to the Four Great Dao Academies.

"If only my Spiritual Root were more exceptional," Chen Mobai sighed. Although the Immortal Sect's motto was "Human will triumphs over fate"—emphasizing that exceptional comprehension, astonishing luck, and meritorious service in the frontier wars could earn one the upper echelons' favor, transforming one's Spiritual Root into a Heavenly Spiritual Root and paving the way for rapid advancement to become a revered ancestor—the truth was that such success stories were rare.
As he lamented, he picked up his chopsticks and selected a chilled slice of fish, savoring its cool, refreshing taste. The satisfying sensation washed over him.
He then retrieved his last Spiritual Power Test Strip and measured his Water Spiritual Root's attribute. As expected, it had temporarily increased by 2 points.

This was the last Azure Carp he had caught near the Water Abode. He had likely overfished the area recently; no Azure Carp dared approach within a kilometer radius anymore. This particular fish had been chilling since yesterday.
Chen Mobai felt no regret, as the Azure Carp were both delicious and enhanced his Spiritual Root attributes.
He didn't waste the fish's potency. While his Spiritual Root attributes were still elevated, he decided to begin cultivating the Five Elements Art.

Ultimately, he abandoned the idea of switching to the Blackwater Art. This was partly because his Water Attribute Spiritual Root hadn't reached the required 33 points, but more importantly, the Blackwater Art lacked any advanced stages beyond Qi Refinement.

Though the Five Elements Art was unremarkable, the Spiritual Power it produced was balanced and harmonious, allowing seamless transitions to other cultivation techniques. Moreover, if he didn't mind its weak combat capabilities, he could redeem Points from the Immortal Sect National Library for the Foundation Establishment and Golden Core Volumes of the Five Elements Art.
Throughout history, the highest cultivation realm achieved with the Five Elements Art belonged to a Nascent Soul Venerable named Qingping from the Heaven Mending Dao Academy.
However, after Qingping Venerable broke through to the Nascent Soul Stage using the Five Elements Art, he immediately switched to another technique.
This was because, even within the same cultivation realm, he couldn't defeat anyone in combat.

Remembering the legend of Teacher Qingping's fondness for "smurfing" (preying on weaker opponents), Chen Mobai inexplicably picked up his phone before starting his cultivation session, opened the Cultivation Assistant app, and typed "Five Elements Art" into the search bar at the top.
After inputting "Five Elements Art," Chen Mobai remembered that his phone had absolutely no signal within the Water Abode.

He chuckled self-deprecatingly and was about to put the phone down to focus on cultivation when a loading circle suddenly appeared on the screen. In a flash, the circle transformed into a Turtle Shell, eventually filling the entire interface. As if a signal had connected, over ten thousand pages of search results flooded the screen.
"This..." Chen Mobai's mouth went dry. The first result on the first page was:
Guaranteed Mastery: Complete Insights on Breaking Through to the Nascent Soul Stage with the Five Elements Art
Author: Qingping
With trembling fingers, he tapped the screen, momentarily forgetting to question why he suddenly had a signal in the Water Abode.
The page loaded instantly with lightning-fast speed.
Chen Mobai found himself on an interface resembling a video-sharing platform, the title matching what he'd seen outside.
This was a video series!
There were twenty-eight videos in total, each thoughtfully labeled with subtitles:
Five Elements Art - First Layer of Qi Refinement
Five Elements Art - Second Layer of Qi Refinement
Five Elements Art - Third Layer of Qi Refinement
All the way to the final video:[Five Elements Art - First Layer of Nascent Soul].
Chen Mobai eagerly scrolled down to the[Five Elements Art - Fifth Layer of Qi Refinement]interface and clicked to open it.
"Hello, students! This is your teacher, Qingping, and today we'll continue explaining the fifth layer of the Five Elements Art."
"Please turn to page 26 in your textbooks. Before we begin today's lesson, let's review yesterday's homework."

"Although this foundational Qi Refinement Technique seems simple, it contains profound knowledge. It could even be considered the foremost Qi Refinement Technique of the Immortal Sect and serves as the very foundation of the sect itself. This is why the Immortal Sect mandates that all cultivators must practice the Five Elements Art during their initial enlightenment."

"Even cultivators with Heavenly Spiritual Roots must cultivate the Five Elements Art to the Seventh Layer before transitioning to techniques aligned with their specific attribute. But what's the reason behind this? In today's lesson, I, Teacher Qingping, will explain this in detail."
Chen Mobai couldn't resist speeding up the video to double speed. Qingping was being far too long-winded.

However, after watching the entire 45-minute instructional video, Chen Mobai's eyes lit up. He immediately replayed the portion where Qingping explained the cultivation of the Five Elements Art at normal speed, listening attentively.
Then, eager to begin, he sat cross-legged on his meditation cushion.
Chen Mobai felt confident that he could now reach the Sixth Layer of Qi Refinement within a month.
